units.source_text: 女子系好腰带，还是时而站起，时而坐下，然后又踱来踱去。

en.t: After tying her sash, the woman still kept getting up and sitting down, then paced back and forth again.

units.source_text: 这种坐立不安的样子，像是夜间动物害怕黎明，焦灼地来回转悠似的。

en.t: Her restlessness was like a nocturnal animal fearing the dawn and anxiously circling back and forth.

units.source_text: 这种奇异的野性使她兴奋起来了。
